content.short: deBridge is a cross-chain messaging and interoperability protocol enabling cross-chain apps with seamless value and message flow.
content.description: deBridge is a generic messaging and cross-chain interoperability protocol that enables developers to build powerful cross-chain applications where value and messages flow seamlessly across networks. The protocol provides a secure infrastructure and framework for cross-chain contract composability, cross-chain asset swaps via deSwap, and bridging of assets and messages in a single transaction. It also supports NFT interoperability, enabling seamless interaction with NFTs across supported chains.
